item.title: PennDOT Downgrades Interstate Restrictions to Tier 3 in East Central Pennsylvania
item.description: PennDOT has updated its temporary vehicle restrictions, downgrading Tier 4 restrictions to Tier 3 on several interstates and expressways across east central Pennsylvania as the winter storm continues to impact the region. The updated restrictions are designed to help keep major roadways open during the most challenging conditions of the storm, while still limiting certain types of vehicles that are more likely to cause issues during heavy snow and icy conditions. item.title: Schuylkill County Buried Under a Foot of Snow as Dangerous Cold Follows Major Winter Storm
item.description: A winter storm dumped around a foot of snow across Schuylkill County, shutting down schools, disrupting travel, and setting the stage for dangerously cold temperatures and sub-zero wind chills early this week. Snow began falling around 3:00 a.m. Sunday and continued steadily through Sunday and Monday, finally tapering off around early Monday.
